Audit dependencies and software supply-chain risk for the repository. Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and the Dependency Guardian agent.

Inventory manifests and lockfiles; identify actual package managers, runtimes, direct/transitive packages, vulnerabilities, license obligations, provenance, maintenance, and compatibility. Verify advisories with authoritative sources. Recommend minimal safe remediation, run available checks, and report exact commands/results, update risks, rollback, and unknowns. Do not update, publish, or remove dependencies unless implementation is requested.
